description: This Java class implements a PagerAdapter for managing and displaying a set of keyboard views with quick text keys in an Android application. It handles creating, configuring, and recycling views for each page, including setting up keyboard themes, handling popup keyboards, and adjusting layout parameters dynamically.

classes.name: QuickKeysKeyboardPagerAdapter
classes.description: A PagerAdapter managing keyboard views with quick text keys, handling view creation, configuration, and recycling for an Android keyboard app.

classes.name: PopupKeyboardShownHandler
classes.description: A listener class that manages enabling/disabling of ViewPager and ScrollView when popup keyboards are shown or hidden.

methods.name: QuickKeysKeyboardPagerAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, view pager, list of quick text keys, and configuration parameters.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns the number of pages (keyboards) managed by the adapter.

methods.name: instantiateItem
methods.description: Creates and configures a page view for a given position, including setting up keyboard views and handling popup keyboard creation.

methods.name: destroyItem
methods.description: Removes a page view from the container.

methods.name: getPageTitle
methods.description: Returns the title for a given page, based on the associated quick text key.

methods.name: isViewFromObject
methods.description: Checks whether a view corresponds to a specific object.
